_comment: Provenance and integrity manifest for the three official competition rasters
used by this repository. The pins below were published in the in-organisation
INDEPENDENTLY RE-MEASURED here on 2026-10-11 by scripts/verify_all.py group B.
All three match exactly. Nothing in this file is asserted without a measurement.

official_source.note: IR-62-DATA-01. Restored instead from the in-organisation git bridge and re-verified against these pins.

band_inventory: Magnetic anomaly - deviation from expected Earth's magnetic field
Reduced to pole magnetic data - magnetic anomaly corrected for latitude effects
Total magnetic intensity horizontal gradient - rate of change in horizontal direction
Geodetic second invariant - measure of strain rate tensor magnitude
Isostatic gravity anomaly slope - gradient of gravity after isostatic correction
Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection
Geodetic shear rate - rate of angular deformation from GPS/InSAR
Geodetic dilatation rate - rate of volumetric strain (expansion/contraction)
Total magnetic intensity vertical gradient - rate of change in vertical direction
Distance to earthquake (n=100km radius, a=15 degrees azimuth parameters)
Isostatic gravity anomaly vertical gradient - vertical rate of change
Detrended elevation - topography with regional trends removed
Isostatic gravity anomaly - gravity after compensating for topographic mass
Total magnetic intensity - total strength of magnetic field
Depth to basement surface - thickness of sedimentary cover
Earthquake intensity or density (n=100km radius, a=15 degrees parameters)
Conductivity surface - electrical conductivity of subsurface
Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change
Detrended elevation slope - gradient of elevation after detrending
files.band_inventory_note: Read from the TIFF DESCRIPTION and data_category tags of the pinned file itself, not assumed. IR-62-DEM-01: there is NO absolute-elevation band; bands 12 and 19 are the only topographic layers and both are derived from DETRENDED elevation.

unavailable.what_it_is: index of USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar DEM download links for the study area
unavailable.consequence: IR-62-DEM-01 stays open. The lane must fit its isobase in detrended-elevation space and cannot resolve metre-scale shoreline benches.
